viewAs.banner: You are viewing the site as @{{name}}. Read-only: nothing can be changed.

dash.storageMore: Trash: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}, {{size}}
dash.extensionMore: New accounts: {{signups}} · to shelves: {{saves}} · connected now: {{connected}}

reports.author: Author:
reports.more: {count, plural, one {# open report} other {# open reports}} on this
reports.closesAll: This closes all open reports on this ({{count}}) and lets each reporter know.

users.deletedAt: Account deleted {{date}}. The username stays reserved.
users.viewAs: View the site as this user
users.banText: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in; their page disappears; open requests with them close. Videos others received from them stay.
users.unbanTitle: Unban @{{name}}? Their page and sign-in come back.
users.deleteText: As if they deleted it themselves: their videos go to the trash and disappear for everyone, the username stays reserved, chats keep “Deleted user”.
users.passwordResetTitle: Send a password reset link to {{email}}?
users.twoFactorResetMessage: Only for a lost phone and lost recovery codes, once you are sure the owner is asking. They get an email and can turn it on again.
users.twoFactorResetDone: Two-step sign-in is off; the owner was emailed.
users.tierUntilHint: Last day included; empty — no end date.

videos.author: @author
videos.toTrashText: It disappears from the site at once, also for {count, plural, one {the person} other {the # people}} holding it (they are notified). The files stay in storage until erased from the trash.
videos.sourceMetaLead: What the uploaded file said about itself. It was taken out of the file; only admins see it here.
videos.sourceMetaOld: Not recorded: uploaded before files were cleaned of their metadata.
videos.sourceMetaRemoved: Streams left out of the file

trash.purgeTitle: Erase {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} from storage for good?
trash.purgeText: Originals, streams, frames and contact sheets ({{size}}) are deleted from S3. This cannot be undone.
trash.purged: Erased: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}, {{size}}.
trash.restored: Restored: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}.
trash.notRestored: Could not restore {{count}}: erased already or the author's account is deleted.

group.out: Left the authors’ trash — only you decide now what happens to them
group.user: Still in the authors’ trash — they can restore these themselves

trash.waiting: {count, plural, one {# video waits} other {# videos wait}} for you
trash.inUserTrashCount: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} still in the authors’ trash
trash.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left to restore
trash.purgeAtAuthor: Videos still in their authors’ trash go too: the authors will no longer be able to restore them.
trash.inUserTrash: Still in the author’s trash: they can restore it themselves.

support.subject: Request
support.replyHint: The author sees it signed “Support” and is told by the bell and email.
support.reopenHint: The ticket is over: an answer opens it again for the author, and their rating is reset.
support.noteHint: Only admins see a note; nobody is told and the status stays.

settings.requestCooldownDays: Days before asking again after a decline
settings.requestHintMinShows: Request hint shows before it can be hidden
settings.hint: Changes apply within a minute, without a restart. Lowering a quota never deletes anything: it only blocks new uploads over the limit. 0 in a download row means no limit; a tier with all three at 0 downloads straight from storage, without the wait page.
settings.trashRetentionDays: Days in the trash before erasing
settings.extensionPerDay: Videos a day through the browser extension
settings.instanceHint: Changes apply within a minute, without a restart. 0 means no limit. Lowering a limit never deletes anything: it only blocks new uploads over it. Downloads are never limited on this server.
settings.paymentGraceDays: Days of Pro after a failed renewal

takedown.messageHint: Optional. Sent with the rule in a notification and an email.
takedown.block: Do not allow this file again
takedown.blockHint: The same file will fail processing if anyone uploads it.
takedown.blocked: This file is on the blocklist.

bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} selected
bulk.hint: Tick videos to act on many at once: the box, or Ctrl/⌘-click and Shift-click on a row.
bulk.toTrashTitle: Move {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} to the trash?
bulk.toTrashText: They disappear from the site at once, also for the people holding them (they are notified). Each author gets the rule and your words. The files stay in storage until erased from the trash.
bulk.removed: Moved to the trash: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}.
bulk.skipped: Skipped {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}: not possible for {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
